daan.vries@example.com · +1-555-006-0606 · Amsterdam, Netherlands
Remote · Hybrid · EU Citizen · Notice period: 30 days
SUMMARY
Daan de Vries is a Principal UI Engineer with 12 years of experience specializing in frontend development.
Based in Amsterdam, Netherlands, Daan has leadership experience guiding engineering teams and utilizing
JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Vue, HTML, CSS, Jest, and Docker. Education includes a bachelor degree in
Computer Science from University of Amsterdam.
